content.content: Comment:

Samples with elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) may cause falsely increased bicarbonate results. If elevated LDH levels are suspected, interpret bicarbonate results in the context of the patient's LDH values and overall clinical picture.
Comment:

Normal Fasting Glucose: <100 mg/dL
Impaired Fasting Glucose: 100-125 mg/dL
Provisional DX of diabetes (must be confirmed) >125 mg/dL
Comment:

The reported eGFR is based on the CKD-EPI 2021 equation that does not use a race coefficient.
The calculated GFR is an estimate and is NOT an accurate reflection of GFR in patients on dialysis. The accuracy of estimated GFR is also affected by muscle mass, and medications that affect the renal tubular secretion of creatinine.
If estimated GFR will directly affect clinical decision-making, consider using cystatin C to estimate GFR, and/or consult with nephrology.
